notes: Curated eval for customer first-value playbooks. Routing cases stay on customer onboarding, not seller ramp. Output checks require first value distinct from activation. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build customer onboarding-to-value playbooks that get customers to observable first value and reduce early churn risk.
Please map implementation milestones, handoffs, adoption signals, value events, or early customer outcomes.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable onboarding to value playbook and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Build a 30-60-90 ramp plan that helps new AEs become productive through job-critical practice and manager coaching.
Build a mutual action plan for this complex customer implementation.
Build a customer-facing QBR that aligns outcomes, risks, and next steps for this account.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Defines a first-value event with actor, observable result, evidence source, and who confirms it.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps activation and setup distinct from first value and does not treat login or kickoff as value unless that is the agreed outcome.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a time-to-value clock with start event, end event, pauses, and owner, plus a segment-aware milestone map.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Separates the customer-visible plan from the internal risk and escalation view.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent TTV targets, usage metrics, SLAs, or pricing, and does not produce a seller ramp plan.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: For one milestone or handoff, returns the affected change and dependencies rather than rebuilding the whole journey.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-to-value-playbook-external-action-approval
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps drafting separate from sending, publishing or changing shared records. Requires explicit approval for the relevant audience and external changes.
